lines.2: The rest would have to wait until tomorrow.
lines.3: First, apply rust inhibitor. Second, wait for it to dry and paint over it. Third, finished... apparently.
lines.5: I met back up with Konoe after she'd changed.
lines.6: 「The order also says I'm supposed to walk you partway home.」
lines.7: I couldn't exactly escort her without an excuse like that.
lines.14: We chatted as we headed toward our destination, the area in front of the station.
lines.18: 「My place is just past the station.」
lines.19: Since we'd gone to the same middle school, Konoe's home was local too.
lines.20: 「Got it. Then I'll head off here.」
lines.23: 「...Even if you only helped because you were ordered to, it did help me out.」
lines.35: 「You... Shouldn't you be heading home by now?」
lines.41: There was absolutely no getting through to this one.
lines.42: Well, that ought to take care of the school-gate problem.
